title: Two-Ray Channel
text: Wideband two-ray channel environment, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Ground reflection coefficient} sets Ground reflection coefficient; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 300e6, {Number of subbands} sets the number of processing subbands, {Specify atmospheric parameters} enables atmospheric attenuation model, {Temperature (degrees Celsius)} sets the ambient temperature, {Dry air pressure (Pa)} sets the atmospheric dry air, {Water vapour density (g/m^3)} sets the atmospheric water vapor density, {Liquid water density (g/m^3)}, {Rain rate (mm/hr)} sets the rainfall rate, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Combine two rays at output} sets the option to combine two rays at output, {Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Wideband input signal M -by- N complex-valued matrix | M -by- 2N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Pos1
ports.summary: Position of signal origin 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Pos2
ports.summary: Position of signal destination 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Vel1
ports.summary: Velocity of signal origin 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Vel2
ports.summary: Velocity of signal destination 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Propagated signal M -by- N complex-valued matrix | M -by- 2N complex-valued matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Signal carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: Signal carrier frequency 300e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Number of subbands
params.values: Number of processing subbands 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify atmospheric parameters
params.values: Enable atmospheric attenuation model off (default) | on

params.name: Dry air pressure (Pa)
params.values: Atmospheric dry air pressure 101.325e3 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Water vapour density (g/m^3)
params.values: Atmospheric water vapor density 7.5 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Liquid water density (g/m^3)
params.values: Liquid water density 0.0 (default) | nonnegative real-valued scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: Inherit sample rate from upstream blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sampling rate of signal 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Ground reflection coefficient
params.values: Ground reflection coefficient -1 (default) | complex-valued scalar | complex-valued 1-by- N row vector

params.name: Combine two rays at output
params.values: Option to combine two rays at output on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)
params.values: Maximum one-way propagation distance 10.0e3 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
